title: Turkish-Style Smoky Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring smoky lamb, served with a tangy tomato sauce and crusty bread.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together Iskender Spice Mix, salt, and black pepper.
3. Brush lamb cubes with olive oil and sprinkle with spice mixture.
4. Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
6. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium heat.
7. Add diced tomatoes, sliced onion, and minced garlic to skillet. Cook for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
8. Stir in chopped parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
9. Serve kebabs hot with tomato sauce and crusty bread.
